translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Jesús eejatzi Zaqueo
Ikanta rareetapaaka Jesús Jericó, ranashitapaakawo nampitsi.
Ikanta reeware apatotziriri koriki iita Zaqueo. Ashaagantzinkari rinatzi.
Ikowaperotake irirori iñeeri Jesús. Iro kantacha te imata osheki atziri otzikaakeriri, ikaamokokitziini eejatzi.
Irojatzi reewatantanakari Zaqueo, ateetapaake inchatoki onkene iñeeri Jesús, tema ari inkenapaakeri.
Ikanta rareetapaaka Jesús rateetakera Zaqueo, raminapaake jenoki, iñaapaakeri, ikantapaakeri: “Zaqueo, payiite intsipaite, ari noshiretawo nimaye pipankoki.”
Intsipaite rayiitanake Zaqueo. Kimoshire raanakeri ipankoki.
Ikanta iñagaitakeri, ñaawaitanake atziripaini ikantzi: “¿Iitaka ikyaawankotantariri Jesús kaariperoshireri?”
Irojatzi ikantantanakari Zaqueo: “Pinkatharí, ari nompakeri ashironkainkari niyanki nashaagawo. Tzimatsirika namatawitakeri nokoshitziri, ari noipiyainiri onkaate 4 nayitakeriri.”
Ikantanake Jesús: “Iroñaaka piñeero pawisakoshiretai. Tema pantanairo poshiyakotanaari rowawiiroki isheninkaani okaakiini Abraham.
Tema iro ripokantakari Itomi Atziri rithotyaakoyetairi ikaatzi peyashiwetainchari, rowawisaakoshireyetairi.”
Roshiyakaawentaitziri 10 koriki

Irojatzi ikemisantaiyakeni atziri ikenkithatzira Jesús. Irojatzi roshiyakaawentantanakanariri, tema ikenkithashirewetaiyani atziripaini koñaawoini impinkathariwentantai Pawa, tema irootaintsi rareetya Jerusalén-ki.
Ikantanake: “Tzimatsi jewari jatake otsipaki nampitsi, impinkatharitakagaiteri, eejatzi ripiyai.
Ipiyotanakeri 10 rimperatanewo, ipanakeri 10 koriki, ikantayetanakeri: ‘Pantawaitakairi koriki nopayetakemiri, irojatzi nipiyantaiyaari.’
Iro kantacha eenitatsi kaari kowerine impinkathariwentante. Rotyaantaitake kantatsine: ‘Te nokowaiyini impinkatharite.’
Ikanta ripiyaa, ipinkatharitakaitakeri. Rapatotapairi rimperatanewo ipayetanakeriranki koriki, ikowi iñeeri tsika ikanta rantawaitakaakeri iyorikite.
Retapaakawo ripokake apaani, ikantapaake: ‘Pinkatharí, nosheñaakerira piyorikite, nagai itsipa ikaatzi 10.’
Ikantanake irirori: ‘Kameethatake nimperatanewo, okamintha pikyaaryootake eepichokiini, aritake piñaakero peewatakaantero nampitsi onkaate 10.’
Ari ripokapaake itsipa rimperatanewo, ikantapaake: ‘Pinkatharí, nosheñagaimiri piyorikite, nagai itsipa ikaatzi 5.’
Eejatzi ikantanakeri irirori: ‘Ari pinkantzityaari eeroka, aritake piñaake peewatakaantero nampitsi onkaate 5.’
Ripokapaake itsipa, ikantapaake: ‘Pinkatharí, jirika piyorikite kameetha noponatakemiri.
Tema antawoite nothaawantzimi imaperotatziimi pimashireyantzitzi, te piñaakota posheñaantariri piyorikite.’
Ikantanake irirori: ‘Kaariperori nimperatanewo pinatzi. Eeroka atsipetyaawone okaatzi pikantakenari. Piyowetaka osheki nomashireyantzitzi, te noñaakoneta nosheñaantariri noorikite.
Piñaawetaka eero pimatziro, pamineme iita antawaitakairineme noorikite, ari ishenineentakeme iroñaaka, iri pimpawainarime nipiyaaga.’
Ari ikantanakeri atziripaini piyotainchari: ‘Paapithateri koriki, pimperi osheñaakeriri ikaatzi 10.’
Ikantaiyanakeni atziri: ‘Pinkatharí, ¿oitaka impantaityaariri, tema tzimatsi rashi irirori 10 koriki pipakeriri inkaaganki?’
Eekero ikantatzi ashitariri iyorikite: ‘Ikaatzi ishekitzimotakeri, ari ishekitzimoperotairi. Iriima kaari ishekitzimoperotzi, eekero iñaatyeeri eero ishekitzimoperotairi.’
Ikantanake eejatzi: ‘Pamakeri ikaatzi kisaneentanari kaari kowatsine nompinkathariwenteri, poñaayenari pithatzinkeri.’ ”
Areetaawo Jesús Jerusalén-ki
Rithonkanakero ikantakeri Jesús, jewatanake riyaatziro Jerusalén-ki.
Ikanta rareetzimataka nampitsiki Betfagé eejatzi Betania imontenampitari otzishi Olivo. Ari rotyaantakeri Jesús apite riyotaanewo.
Ikantakeri: “Piyaate nampitsiki amontenampitakari. Ari piñaapaakeri ewonkeri burro inthatakotya, tekera ikyaakagaitariita. Pinthataryaakoteri, pamakenari jaka.
Arika rosampiitawakemi: ‘¿Piiterika pithataryaakotantariri burro?’ Pinkantanakeri eeroka: ‘Ikowatziiri Pinkathari.’ ”
Jataiyanakeni rotyaantaitakeri, iñaakero okaatzi ikantaitakeriri.
Ithataryaakotapaakeri burro. Rosampitakeri ashitariri, ikantziri: “¿Piiterika pithataryaakotantariri?”
Ikantanake irirori: “Ikowatziiri Pinkathari.”
Irojatzi ramantakanariri Jesús. Rowanketakeniri manthakintsi imitzikaaki, ikyaakaanakari Jesús.
Ikanta ranashitakaanakari Jesús burro, romaankashiitanakeri manthakintsi awotsiki inkenanakera.
Ikanta riyotaapiintziri Jesús, oirinkimatanaka otzishiki Olivo, ikaimaiyini ithaamentawentari Pawa, tema iñaapiintziri ritasonkawentantzi Jesús.
Ikantaiyini:

content.text: ¡Kaakitataike awinkatharite! Tasonkawentaarewo rinatzi, tema Pinkathari aitziri otyaantakeriri.
¡Iri kameethatatsiri oshekitzimotziri rowaneenkawo Pawa nampitawori ojenokiperotzinta inkite!

content: Ikanta Fariseo saikayetaintsiri eejatzi janta, ikantakeri Jesús: “Yotaantanerí, pinkisathateri piyotaanewo.”
Rakanake Jesús, ikantzi: “Arika nomairyaakeri ikaatzi kaimayetaintsiri, aritake onkaimanake mapi iroori.”
Ikanta rareetzimatapaakaga Jesús Jerusalén-ki, riraakotapaakawo iñaapaakerowa.

Ikantzi: “¡Osheki onkameethateme pinkemathatawakityeerome eepichokiini iroñaaka, irootake kiteesheri piñaantaiyaawori pisaikai kameetha! Iro kantzimaitacha eero imata tema mawityaaki ikantakagaitakemi.
Tema irootaintsi ripoke kisaneentzimiri, riwetsikashitapaakemi rithonkantemiri. Rithonka rotzikapaakemi iweyaaga potanto, eero piñiiro tsika pinkene pishiye.
Ari intzimpookaitakemi, rashiryagaityaari maawoini. Eero iñagaitairo mapipaini okaatzi pewiryaayetachari iroñaaka, okantakaantziro te piyotawakeri tsika itzimi pokashiwetakemiri.”
Rookapaakeri Jesús yompariyetachari tasorentsipankoki
Ikanta ikyaapaake Jesús tasorentsipankoki, rookapaakeri yompariyetachari.

Ikantayetziri: “Pairani rosankenaitakero kantatsiri: ‘Nopanko inatzi jiroka, ari ramanapiintaitenari.’ Iro kantzimaitacha eeroka pamatawitantapiintake jaka pipimantayetzi, poshiyakaakero koshintzipanko.”

Rashi rowapaakitziiro Jesús riyotaantzi kiteesheriki tasorentsipankoki. Iri kantacha reeware Imperatasorentsitaneri, itsipatakari Yotzinkariite eejatzi Antariite, raminaminatakero tsika inkenakairo rowamaakaanteri.
Te iñiimaita tsika inkenakairo, tema owayempita ikantaiyakani atziripaini ikemisantziri Jesús.

footnotes.text: Kantakotachari jaka “inchato”, irootake iitaitziri otsipaki nampitsi sicómoro.
Ikantakoitziri jaka “koriki”, iriitake iitaitziri pairani “mina”. Raantaityaariri mina, ontzimatye rantawentaiteri inkaate mawa kashiri.
